card.name: Linking words before dose numbers in CML drug text
card.fires_on: Small linking words or spaces (of, and, receiving, a hyphen, a space before a digit) right before a drug name or number in dosing and adverse-event text, mostly for leukemia drugs like nilotinib and asciminib.

modes.label: of/and before dose
modes.description: The word of or and just before a dose amount or a second drug name.
modes.example: The recommended dose<< of>> SCEMBLIX is 20

modes.label: Space before grade number
modes.description: A space or hyphen just before a grade or number.
modes.example: Resume ITOVEBI at one lower dose level. Grade<< >>4 Permanently discontinue ITO
